ABOUT QUANTUMLOOPAI
QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.
You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Backend and Frontend Test Automation

• Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.

• Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.

• Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

• Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.

• Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.

• Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.

• Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.

Quality Evaluation and Defect Management

• Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.

• Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.

• Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

Requirements
ESSENTIAL

• 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.

• Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.

• Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.

• Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).

• Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.

• Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.

• Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.

• Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.

• Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

• Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.

• Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.

• Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.

• Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.

• Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.

• Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

LOGISTICS

• Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.

• Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

• Start date: Flexible.

Benefits
WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive package depending on experience

• Potential share options

• Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support

• The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies

• Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture

• Direct collaboration with engineering, AI/ML and product teams

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT
At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

• Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work

• Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context

• Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform

• Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.
DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION
We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.
RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE
QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses.
COME WORK WITH US
Ready to own quality for a live voice AI platform? We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact

Headquarters: Remote (North America)

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.
About The Role 

As an Deployment Architect, you will be the force behind successful deployments at Hightouch. Working in close partnership with an account team and the Hightouch product team, you will own the full deployment and enablement lifecycle for Hightouch customers. You will be the primary point of contact for customers during deployment and are responsible for executing the technical aspects of customer onboarding, ensuring seamless integration of Hightouch into customers' existing data infrastructure.

In this role, you will be the product expert who translates complex customer requirements into actionable implementation plans. You should have a natural ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both data engineering teams and business stakeholders. As the primary owner of the deployment lifecycle, your focus is on creating repeatable, efficient implementation processes that scale across our customer base while maintaining the flexibility to address unique enterprise needs.

What You’ll Do

• Drive the onboarding process for customers, working closely with the Account team to ensure alignment between technical execution and customer success objectives

• Design and optimize deployment frameworks that can scale across different customer segments while accommodating enterprise-specific requirements

• Lead technical discovery sessions and implementation workshops, collaborating with customer data engineering teams and business stakeholders

• Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for deployments, including integration specifications, data models, and best practices

• Develop and execute implementation plans that minimize time-to-value while ensuring robust, sustainable solutions

• Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and resolve technical blockers that could impact customer success

• Build relationships with technical stakeholders within customer organizations

• Contribute to product development by providing feedback to our engineering team

• Standardize and automate implementation processes to increase team efficiency and customer satisfaction

What We're Looking For

• 5-10 years of experience in technical implementation, solutions architecture, or similar roles with enterprise software

• Strong technical background with hands-on experience in data integration, APIs, and enterprise architecture

• Proven track record of successfully managing complex technical implementations while maintaining clear communication with a variety of stakeholders

• The ability to tackle the most ambiguous customer problems (the "that can't be done" ones) and find a creative paths to successful implementation

• Experience creating and optimizing implementation processes that can scale across an organization

• Excellence in technical project management with ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills with ability to command a room of technical and business audiences

• Experience working with data warehouses, ETL processes, and marketing technology is a plus

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience)

The salary range for this position is $140,000-$180,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own critical business data end to end and help teams make better decisions with it.

You’ll build the metrics, dashboards and analyses that become the single source of truth across the business, while partnering closely with teams to solve high-impact problems and uncover growth opportunities.

This role is for someone who can independently navigate messy data, define the right questions, and turn analysis into clear decisions and action.

The Job

• Own business data as a reliable source of truth by ensuring key metrics, reports and dashboards are accurate, consistent and trusted across teams.
• Build and evolve decision-making systems across business, marketing, finance and other core functions through dashboards, reporting and analytical frameworks.
• Turn complex datasets into actionable insights by writing advanced SQL, analysing large datasets, and identifying trends, anomalies and opportunities.
• Define the metrics that matter by partnering with teams to establish KPIs, improve measurement and create clarity around performance.
• Lead data-driven problem solving by independently structuring ambiguous business questions, diagnosing root causes and recommending actions that improve outcomes.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You

• Have 3-6 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics or a similar role, ideally in a fast-moving consumer or technology business.
• Are exceptionally strong in SQL and comfortable independently working with large, complex and imperfect datasets.
• Have strong experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase, and can build dashboards that drive decisions rather than just report numbers.
• Bring strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
• Have exposure to Python or a strong understanding of how data flows through products and technology systems.

What You Can Expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s What You Can Expect

• Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
• Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
• A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
• Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
• Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
• Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
• Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
• An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel
